name: rehAIbilitation
source:
A lolita travels to an isolated place in hopes of fixing herself, leaving behind something dear to her. She meets a peculiar nurse.

[From [url=https://ophanimkei.itch.io/rehai]itch.io[/url]]

洛丽塔前往一个偏僻的地方，希望能够修复自己，并留下一些她心爱的东西。她遇到了一位奇特的护士。
